question: Which Gupta king led an expedition to western India where he overcame the last of the Shakas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chandragupta Vikramaditya:

 
 
• **Chandragupta II** was the third Gupta ruler after Samudragupta.
 
• This famous Gupta ruler was known for his title Vikramaditya or Chandragupta Vikramaditya.
 
• We know about him from inscriptions and coins.
 
• He led an expedition to western India, where he overcame the last of the Shakas.
 
• According to later beliefs, his court was full of learned people, including Kalidasa the poet, and Aryabhata the astronomer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• In the official answer key, Samudragupta is mentioned as the correct answer. But as per NCERT Chandragupta II is correct. Hence we have marked Chandragupta II as the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Gupta Ruler**
 **About**
 
 

 Kumaragupta
 
 
 
• He was the son of Chandragupta II and grandson of the Great Samudragupta
 
• He built the world-famous ancient Nalanda University.
 
• He was also called **Shakraditya**
 
 
 
 

 Chandragupta I
 
 
 
• Title- **Maharajadhiraja**
 
• He was the grandson of Sri Gupta who is the first known ruler of the Gupta Dynasty
 
• The Allahabad Pillar inscription indicates that Chandragupta I reigned for a long time.
 
• Married Lichchavi princess Kumaradevi
 
 
 
 

 Samudragupta
 
 
 
• Called ‘Napolean of India’ by V.A. Smith (Irish Indologist and Art Historian)
 
• His campaigns are mentioned in the Eran inscription (Madhya Pradesh)
